cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Lighting maintenance. We shouldn't let logistics overshadow flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful note for whoever organises next year's logistics.

confusable: Not honestly analyzing the effect of A intervention: A conceals its role in unequal visibility while continuing to pronounce the result fair.
comparison: Physical display advantage versus identifiable raffle ticket.
